auditor.independence: Auditor session b973c86b28e4 (task role, lopdev lane move-working-set, manager 35c4f00e8d73). Translator was a different session: agent coder, job eacba7a3806e, session 76c99189cb1d. Same served model family as the translator (anthropic/claude-opus-5-5), different agent and run; no fallback. No MT or translation API used.

findings.problem: push is rendered with 'отправить' — the same verb this dialog uses for 'send to {device}'. The main warning reads 'отправит все его рабочие файлы на {device}: рабочие деревья ниже с неотправленными коммитами' ('will send … the worktrees with their unsent commits'), and the remedies 'Отправьте коммиты' / 'Перед перемещением отправьте или зафиксируйте всё, что вам нужно' read as 'send it yourself', not git push. ru.md wave-2 keeps push Latin undeclined and the corpus says 'выполнили push'. Only reason_over_cap disambiguates ('в удалённый репозиторий'). The consent text no longer states clearly what is pushed versus what is sent.
findings.fix: Keep push Latin: 'коммитами без push' / '{n} коммит без push' in worktree_counts; remedies 'Выполните push или перепишите коммит…', 'Выполните push коммитов или уберите их…', 'Перед перемещением выполните push или зафиксируйте всё, что вам нужно', '…или отменить и сначала выполнить push или зафиксировать работу'. 'незафиксированные'/'зафиксируйте' for commit is git-ru standard and does not collide, so it may stay.

findings.problem: 'память сеанса' — the glossary's session row is 'сессия' and the ru corpus has 0 uses of 'сеанс'.
'Я уверен, что…' is masculine-only in a required first-person consent checkbox (the sibling checkbox_leave 'Я понимаю' is neutral).

findings.note: Mechanical checks on the committed bytes at dd014c1e9d (scratch script run with the repo's @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser): key set equals English; the base..head diff of this file is exactly the 42 added working_set_* lines (0 changed, 0 removed values, so every other value is the bytes audited by the superseded row); every audited value parses and carries the same arguments, types and ::group-off skeletons as English; plural arms present for every CLDR category of the locale and no foreign arm; NFC; no bidi controls (U+200E/F, U+202A-E, U+2066-9, U+061C); no ASCII '...'; no leading/trailing/double spaces; no <Trans> tags in this namespace. Rendered fit NOT verified in this lane (no rendered frames).
reason_over_cap already disambiguates ('Отправьте его в удалённый репозиторий'); it is listed under RU-1 only for consistency of the push rendering.
